basis: GameStop’s June 7 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated statements of operations reported net sales of $1,237.1 million for the 13 weeks ended April 29, 2023, against $1,378.4 million for the 13 weeks ended April 30, 2022. The fiscal Q1 2023 actual was $72.38 million below the $1,309.48 million cutoff. The earlier releases, management remarks, filings, and investor-presentation search yielded no numeric Q1 2023 consolidated sales outlook.

coverage.detail: December 7, 2022, preceding earnings cycle. GameStop reported fiscal Q3 2022 net sales of $1.186 billion and gave no fiscal Q1 2023 sales range. On the accompanying call, CEO Matt Furlong said management was providing no formal guidance.

March 21, 2023, immediately preceding earnings release. Net sales of $2,226.4 million covered the 13 weeks ended January 28, 2023. Management outlined its strategy for profitability and growth without quantifying fiscal Q1 2023 sales.

March 21 public earnings call, preserved in a third-party transcript. Furlong anticipated transformation charges in Q1 2023 and explicitly said, “we're not delivering guidance at this time.” He gave no quarterly sales figure.
March 28 fiscal 2022 Form 10-K discussed cost reductions, store operations, and sustained profitability. It supplied no consolidated sales estimate for the quarter ending April 29.
May 2 proxy statement. The CEO’s stockholder letter discussed European wind-downs, including Ireland, and a goal of profitability. It gave no Q1 consolidated sales figure or range.
May 30 investor notice scheduled fiscal Q1 results for after market close on June 7. It contained no preliminary sales or updated guidance.
June 7 earnings release, furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The GAAP net-sales row gives both quarterly amounts to the nearest $0.1 million on the same reported consolidated basis.
June 7 companion Exhibit 99.2 announced Ryan Cohen’s election as executive chairman and the former CEO’s termination. It contained no sales disclosure.

publication_date_evidence: GameStop’s IR release is dated June 7, 2023, and says the company released results that day for the quarter ended April 29. EDGAR independently records acceptance of the 8-K carrying the earnings release on June 7 at 16:30:55 Eastern.
